description: Brian explores the physical rules behind shape, motion, matter and light, showing how the same fundamental laws appear in spectacular natural phenomena across Earth.

s03e01.description: Brian shows how the diversity of natural shapes reflects underlying physical rules, from human towers and honeycombs to icebergs and snowflakes.

s03e02.description: Brian follows Earth’s motion through space and uses tides, seasons and relativity to explore the deeper nature of space and time.

s03e03.description: Brian investigates the chemical ingredients of Earth and how the properties of matter and water became the basis for life.

s03e04.description: Brian explores colour and light, showing how interactions between radiation and matter shape Earth and help us search for distant Earth-like worlds.
